observation.happening: Compact recording control bar in progress, showing elapsed time and quick access to memo, captions, and Ask Astra feature.
observation.most_important: Recording status is immediately clear with red indicator and '録音中' text; time counter (00:02) is prominently displayed.
observation.next_action: User can pause, adjust captions, add memo, or ask Astra a question without stopping.

7DBD.why: Well-crafted recording control bar with crystal-clear state indication via red dot and '録音中' label. Density and geometry are solid. However, design follows a very predictable control-bar pattern seen across similar apps—nothing distinctive, but nothing broken.

observation.happening: Meeting notes document with left navigation sidebar and detailed structured content showing summary, decisions, action items, and full transcript with timestamps and speaker attribution.
observation.most_important: Clear information hierarchy: title at top, summary section with decision markers [1], action items [2][3], then detailed transcript organized by timestamp and speaker name.
observation.next_action: User can expand sections, click reference links, review transcript with speaker attribution, or access related files.

808D.why: Outstanding execution across hierarchy, typography, and geometry. The structured sections (summary → decisions → actions → transcript) are immediately clear. Reference markers and color-coded speaker names show meticulous craft. Whitespace is abundant. Layout is precise and professional without feeling cold. Minor: design follows professional task-app patterns (Linear, Notion aesthetic) rather than breaking new ground.

observation.happening: Meeting interface with permission warning blocking transcript functionality. Left sidebar shows status (microphone + screen audio monitoring, voice recognition active). Right panel is mostly empty awaiting transcript.
observation.most_important: Warning banner with orange triangle warning about missing voice recognition permission—blocks main feature (transcription). Users told to open settings.
observation.next_action: User must open settings to grant permission before transcription can begin.
anomalies: Right panel is nearly empty—large unused space
Warning message creates cognitive friction in otherwise simple permission issue
Three status indicators on left (microphone, screen audio, voice recognition) create slight redundancy

ai_look: Permission dialog presentation feels like a template pattern; OAuth flow disclosure is somewhat heavy-handed
8688.why: Interface is functional but incomplete. Left panel (status indicators) is clear. Right panel is vast empty space, making the interface feel unfinished. The orange warning banner creates unnecessary anxiety for what should be a simple permission request. State clarity is muddled—unclear whether the app is ready or waiting. Craft is competent but not polished. Design pattern is generic.

observation.most_important: Meeting transcript is flowing (03:53–04:18 with speaker names), but modal interrupts with resource disclosure.
observation.next_action: User must acknowledge or close modal to continue focusing on meeting.
anomalies: Modal overlaid at bottom disrupts meeting flow
Three resource icons (File, Gmail, Drive) with sparse explanation

ai_look: Modal presentation is templated disclosure pattern; data access explanation feels bolted-on rather than integrated
89A8.why: Main interface (transcript with speakers and timestamps) is clear and functional. However, bottom modal overlay interrupts calm meeting experience—feels like a forced disclosure rather than organic feature integration. Modal density is low with sparse explanations. Attention is fractured between meeting content and resource notification. Design is competent but the modal presentation strategy reduces elegance.

observation.happening: Empty Tasks state in a task/work management app. Prominent blue 'Task Dock を開く' button with helpful hints about what can be done.
observation.most_important: Empty state is clearly communicated ('まだ仕事はありません' = 'No tasks yet'). Blue CTA button is very prominent.
observation.next_action: User can open Task Dock to start creating tasks, or explore suggestions.

ai_look: Helpful hints section with arrow bullets follows a standard 'empty state suggestions' template
8E15.why: Empty state design is well-executed with clear messaging, prominent CTA button, and helpful hints. Whitespace is ample and calming. Typography hierarchy is clear. However, this empty state pattern is extremely common (seen in task managers, to-do apps, etc.). No distinctive visual identity—appears similar to Linear, Asana, Notion empty states. Excellent execution of a standard pattern.

observation.happening: Detailed meeting document with full structured content: title, summary, decision section (決まったこと2), action items (やること3), and transcript with full speaker attribution and timestamps.
observation.most_important: Clear hierarchical structure: title → summary → decisions → actions → detailed transcript. Reference numbers and speaker names provide excellent organization.
observation.next_action: User can navigate sections, review actions with speaker context, or expand transcript details.

91B8.why: Exceptional design across all dimensions. Hierarchy is crystal clear: title dominates, sections are distinctly marked, transcript is well-organized with timestamps and speaker attribution. Typography uses weight and size masterfully to guide the eye. Geometry is precise—every element aligns perfectly. Craft is evident in reference markers [1][2][3] and proper speaker name coloring. Whitespace is abundant and intentional. Only minor: visual style aligns with professional task apps rather than pioneering a unique aesthetic.
